text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph response with an introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay shows a clearer overall structure and progression of ideas."},{"evidence":"repeated reasons like \"My first reason\" and \"My second reason\"","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its response with multiple supporting points rather than a few fragments."},{"evidence":"sentences such as \"I want to learn new things\" and \"I would want to visit the zoo because I wanna see different types of animals\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay forms complete sentences much more consistently, even if they are often simple or awkward."},{"evidence":"connected ideas with \"First, Second, Additionally, My last reason, In conclusion\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay uses transitions and repeated reference to the main topic to link ideas across the response."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"how it is like,\" \"what happens when an animal get sick,\" and \"working at the zoo it can be hard\"","quality":"communicative clarity","description":"The essay conveys a recognizable central message and related details, whereas the other essay is largely fragmentary."},{"evidence":"mostly readable wording despite errors such as \"wanna\" and \"dont\"","quality":"readability","description":"The essay remains understandable across a much larger stretch of text."}]}
